thread:
maria (pm): OK team — RC ready for promotion. Build RC-2026-03-21-7 validated in staging, smoke pass ✅. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/RC-2026-03-21-7
jon (eng): ✅ I ran the final integration tests. No new lint or schema diffs. Pin request: `pin model-serving@v1.14.2` and artifact `service-api@sha:fa3b9e2`
kevin (release-engineer): Rolling window is 02:00-04:00 UTC (quiet window). Ops ready for gradual shift. Can we add a KV warm step and a 5% initial traffic cohort?
maria (pm): yes to KV warm. 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% over 30m steps. Add the escape-hatch condition: if p99 latency increases > 40% or error-rate > 0.6% then pause and rollback.
olivia (sre): noting SLO variance check: baseline p99=120ms, error-rate=0.08%. I'll watch telemetry and set alert thresholds accordingly.
kevin (release-engineer): deploy-bot, please schedule canary with pins and KV warm. Use `--kv-warm=true --cohorts=5,25,100 --pin=service-api@fa3b9e2,model-serving@v1.14.2`
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted by release-bot. Job ID: 2026-03-21-rc4291012345. Starting canary in 10m. Progress notifications will appear in this thread.
jon (eng): small FYI — the quantized fallback branch is hot-fixed in staging if we need to flip quickly: `service-api --rollout-variant=quant-q8`
maria (pm): thanks. Please keep the release notes linked in the deploy message and include the changelog snippet for customer-impacting items.
kevin (release-engineer): doing final pin in infra config now. Pushing commit to release-candidate branch.
deploy-bot: Canary started. Cohort 1 -> 5% traffic. KV warming in progress.
olivia (sre): KV warm complete. Initial telemetry looks healthy. p50/p90/p99: 22ms / 86ms / 118ms. error-rate 0.07%
jon (eng): check: model-serving memory jumped +12% on a specific pod earlier but GC stabilized, not seeing OOMs. I'll keep an eye.
kevin (release-engineer): Cohort 2 scheduled in 12m (25% traffic) if metrics hold.
deploy-bot: Cohort 2 promoted. Traffic at 25%.
maria (pm): quick check — are there any slow downstreams in traces?
olivia (sre): tracing shows a small tail on db-read for a subset of requests (+60ms on 0.4% of traces). Not correlated with errors yet. I'll keep a close watch.
jon (eng): I can roll a small patch to use read-replica if it spikes, but hold until we see impact.
kevin (release-engineer): Cohort 3 -> 100% scheduled in 20m. All gates green so far.
deploy-bot: Cohort 3 promoting now.
maria (pm): heads-up: marketing webhook will trigger after full promo. They should be ok but FYI to support.
olivia (sre): alert triggered: p99 increased to 168ms (baseline 120ms) and error-rate at 0.42% — this is below escape-hatch error threshold but above latency threshold. Pausing promotion.
kevin (release-engineer): acknowledging pause. Reverting traffic to 25% until we triage. Rolling back cohort 3 promotion.
jon (eng): thumbs — looking into traces now. If we can't identify quick fix, we should consider rolling back to previous RC.
maria (pm): agree. This is why we call it an escape hatch. Olivia, can you post the top-3 affected endpoints and the trace id samples?
olivia (sre): top-3: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream, /v1/embeddings. Samples: trace ids t-8a3c, t-8a7f, t-8b12. Sending links to traces: https://tracing.redwood/trace/t-8a3c etc.
jon (eng): seeing a surge of long tail in transformer step times for requests > 1024 tokens. It may be a model KV cache cold path degeneracy on certain shards.
kevin (release-engineer): options: 1) continue partial rollout while we mitigate shard hotness, 2) flip to quantized fallback `quant-q8` which has lower latency variance, 3) rollback to previous RC. Thoughts?
maria (pm): preference for minimal customer impact — option 2 if it's a quick flip and tested in staging. How fast can we flip?
jon (eng): I can flip traffic to the quantized variant in ~5m if SRE gives the go-ahead. It's already uploaded and smoke-tested in staging. Performance tradeoffs confirmed.
olivia (sre): canary metrics for quant-q8 in staging: p99 140ms, error-rate 0.09% — lower tail but slightly higher p50. That's acceptable for now. I give go from SRE side.
kevin (release-engineer): executing variant flip for cohort at 25%: `deploy-bot promote-variant --job=2026-03-21-rc4291012345 --variant=quant-q8 --cohort=25`
deploy-bot: Variant flip initiated. Monitoring telemetry for affected cohort.
olivia (sre): after flip p99 back to 126ms, error-rate 0.08%. No regressions seen.
maria (pm): nice — can we continue the remaining promotion to 100% with the quantized variant, or should we hold another full interval?
on (typo): [no message]
jon (eng): recommend continuing with the plan but increase the step duration to 20m for final jump, so we can observe.
kevin (release-engineer): acknowledged — slowing final step. Cohort 3 -> 100% will start after 20m monitor period.
kevin (release-engineer): scheduling final promote. Deploy-bot, proceed when green.
deploy-bot: Final promote started. 100% traffic shifting to RC-2026-03-21-7 (variant=quant-q8). Post-promotion checks running.
olivia (sre): post-promote telemetry: p99 129ms, error-rate 0.085%. All within the escape-hatch bounds. No additional alerts.
maria (pm): official sign-off: I'm green to call this promoted. Release notes link again: https://redwood.internal/notes/RC-2026-03-21-7. Please add an ops-runbook entry about the quantized fallback and the KV shard hotness to the postmortem checklist.
jon (eng): will add a follow-up PR to improve KV shard balancing.
kevin (release-engineer): tagging the release in repo: `git tag rc-2026-03-21-7 && git push --tags`. Pin recorded in infra: `model-serving@v1.14.2`, `service-api@fa3b9e2`, variant `quant-q8` set as active.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Job ID 2026-03-21-rc4291012345. All cohorts stable.
maria (pm): thanks everyone. I'll schedule the short post-release retro and capture the escape-hatch timeline. :tada:
olivia (sre): adding timeline to incident-log and closing monitoring thread unless something else pops up.
jon (eng): thumbs. I'll follow up with the KV shard fix.
kevin (release-engineer): out.
deploy-bot: This thread will remain archived as the release record for job 2026-03-21-rc4291012345.
